specificSetting: innovation and local identity planning brief 15

tasks.scenario: Two source texts debating whether innovation strengthens or erodes local identity in small businesses.
tasks.purpose: Synthesise competing claims, evaluate assumptions, and develop an independent position on the balance between innovation and identity.
requiredContentPoints: innovation as survival strategy vs. erosion of distinctiveness
practical consequences for small businesses and communities
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Scenario is original; no reuse of source-text theses from previous tests. Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Review of a small business that successfully integrates innovation while retaining local character.
tasks.purpose: Assess effectiveness of innovation-identity integration and recommend as a model.
requiredContentPoints: description of business and specific innovations
assessment of integration without loss of identity
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Review genre with concrete business focus; no overlap with previous review tasks. Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Report on how innovation expectations affect small businesses and local identity, for a programme coordinator.
tasks.purpose: Analyse implications of innovation pressure and propose actions to support balanced innovation.
requiredContentPoints: analysis of impact of innovation requirements
consequences for local economy and community character
two practical actions to help businesses innovate without losing identity
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Report with specific institutional audience; no reuse of report scenarios from previous tests. Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Article arguing a position on whether small businesses should prioritise innovation or tradition, with request for follow-up discussion.
tasks.purpose: Explain a position, describe a practical consequence, and request arrangements for further discussion.
requiredContentPoints: one practical consequence of preferred approach
suggestion for implementation while maintaining trust
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Article with persuasive and request elements; no reuse of article scenarios from previous tests. Forbidden concepts avoided.
